entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
My new VeloBand Pulse is not working.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Could I start with your name and the order number, please?
Mark Peterson. Order number is VF88602.
Thank you, Mark. I have your order right here. To understand better, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's broken. The thing just won't sync with my phone. I've done everything the instructions say. It's defective.
I see, and I apologize for that experience. A brand new device should work perfectly out of the box. Let me just quickly check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Alright, thank you for your patience, Mark. I've pulled up our policy, and I see your VeloBand was delivered just nine days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can absolutely process a return for a full refund for you.
Great. It shouldn't be this hard. Whatever, just send me the label.

Of course. I have just processed that for you. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and return instructions within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the defective unit, we'll issue your refund. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Okay. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
